description:
The Next-Gen Collaboration Suite

Lark is a next-generation office suite that integrates messaging, schedule management, collaborative documents, video conferencing, and many more applications in a single platform.
Messenger
- You can now speak instead of typing out your messages on Lark desktop. Voice input converts your speech into concise, structured text by recognizing key terms and names, removing unnecessary filler and repetition, and formatting the content into clear paragraphs.
